title: I successfully exported an AOT Android build using Godot 4.4.1 mono version in my Debian 12 virtual machine, but it throws an error at runtime.
body:
### Tested versions


godot4.4.1mono

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono unknown - Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) 12 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - (software emulation on CPU) llvmpipe (LLVM 15.0.6, 256 bits) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400 (4 threads)

### Issue description

04-10 15:06:18.686  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: _load (core/io/resource_loader.cpp:344)
04-10 15:06:18.686  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Failed loading scene: res://label.tscn.
04-10 15:06:18.686  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: start (main/main.cpp:4301)
04-10 15:06:18.709  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Condition "default_certs != nullptr" is true.
04-10 15:06:18.709  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: load_default_certificates (modules/mbedtls/crypto_mbedtls.cpp:352)
04-10 15:06:18.709  3362  3386 I godot   : oi1::res://label.tscn.remap
04-10 15:06:18.709  3362  3386 I godot   : oi2::label.tscn.remap
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 I godot   : oi1::res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-da3c52c1d1e8632f6d27195cf30ab181-label.scn

04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: No loader found for resource: res://Label1.cs (expected type: Script)
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: _load (core/io/resource_loader.cpp:359)
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Can't load dependency: 'res://Label1.cs'.
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: parse_variant (core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:459)
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Error when trying to parse Variant.
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: parse_variant (core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:503)
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Error when trying to parse Variant.
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   :    at: parse_variant (core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:490)
04-10 15:06:18.710  3362  3386 E godot   : ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-da3c52c1d1e8632f6d27195cf30ab181-label.scn. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
Loops report these errors.
No errors occurred during the export.

### Steps to reproduce

<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.4.1">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <EnableDynamicLoading>true</EnableDynamicLoading>
    <PublishAOT>true</PublishAOT>
      <PublishAotUsingRuntimePack>true</PublishAotUsingRuntimePack>
      <CppCompilerAndLinker>/home/yscysc/Android/Sdk/ndk/23.2.8568313/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/clang</CppCompilerAndLinker>  
      
  <ObjCopyName>/home/yscysc/Android/Sdk/ndk/23.2.8568313/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-objcopy</ObjCopyName>  

  </PropertyGroup>
 <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Root the assemblies to avoid trimming. -->
    <TrimmerRootAssembly Include="GodotSharp" />
    <TrimmerRootAssembly Include="$(TargetName)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>


I modified the source code based on PR97908 and successfully exported it.
